page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on KVM virtualization architecture. The instance features 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It includes 256.0 GB of memory, which provides a standard 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU allocation.

Network performance is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance carries no local NVMe or SSD storage and includes no discrete GPU acceleration units, requiring block storage volumes for persistent data retention.

The 64-core dedicated allocation combined with a balanced memory ratio offers solid compute density for enterprise scale environments without paying extra for local storage hardware. Suitable workload deployments include enterprise web application hosting, build and compilation pipelines, container orchestration control planes, and distributed caching systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. Powered by Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz, it supplies 64 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Network performance reaches a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance lacks local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage for operational data, and includes no GPU hardware. Its dedicated core count and standard memory allocation offer cost-effective compute density for concurrent enterprise workloads. The ecs.g5.16xlarge is suited for enterprise application servers, web server farms, software compilation pipelines, container orchestration nodes, and distributed cache infrastructure.
